# ASOWin

> ASOWin is a global App Store Optimization (ASO) agency with teams in the USA, India, Indonesia and Singapore, offering ASO, app reputation management, Apple Search Ads and paid UA, creative A/B testing and AI-powered review replies.

ASOWin grows app rankings, ratings and installs on the Apple App Store and Google Play for brands in fintech, e-commerce, gaming and consumer apps. Clients include Pepperfry, Bybit, Indiabulls Securities, LSM Apps and Viker Games (see case studies below). Offices: California, Delaware, Jakarta, Singapore, Mumbai and Noida. Contact: support@asowin.com.

## Services
- [App Store Optimization](https://www.asowin.com/services/app-store-optimization/): keyword research, metadata, competitor analysis and localization for the App Store and Google Play
- [App Reputation Management](https://www.asowin.com/services/app-reputation-management/): review monitoring, review replies, in-app rating prompt strategy and issue analysis
- [Creative A/B Testing & Design](https://www.asowin.com/services/creative-ab-testing/): icons, screenshots, preview videos and store listing A/B tests
- [Paid User Acquisition & Apple Search Ads](https://www.asowin.com/services/paid-user-acquisition/): Apple Search Ads and app install campaigns planned alongside ASO
- [Automated ASO with AI](https://www.asowin.com/services/automated-aso-ai/): AI review analysis, reply drafts, change alerts and reporting, reviewed by ASO specialists
- [Keyword Installs](https://www.asowin.com/services/keyword-installs/): keyword-targeted install campaigns alongside ASO
- [AI Review Replies](https://www.asowin.com/automated-review-replies/): ASOWin's AI product that replies to app reviews in a brand's voice
- [Google Play Store Optimization](https://www.asowin.com/google-play-store-optimization/): ASO for Google Play listings
- [All services](https://www.asowin.com/services/)

## Case studies
- [Pepperfry](https://www.asowin.com/success-stories/pepperfry/): app rating improved from about 3.9 to 4.4+
- [Bybit](https://www.asowin.com/success-stories/bybit/): Top 3 rankings in Spain and Latin America through Spanish-language ASO
- [Indiabulls Securities](https://www.asowin.com/success-stories/indiabulls-securities/): 50+ keywords moved from unranked into the Top 50 on both stores
- [LSM Apps](https://www.asowin.com/success-stories/lsm-apps/): Easy Phone moved from #10 to #2 for "Phone" on US Google Play
- [Viker Games](https://www.asowin.com/success-stories/viker-games/): #1 Top Free Games in Australia and 500,000+ installs in one day
- [All case studies](https://www.asowin.com/success-stories/)
